commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
90+5' Auxerre get a corner.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lamine Sy (Auxerre).
90+5' Close! Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) stands over the resulting free kick from around 23 metres out and his shot goes just over the crossbar.
90+3' Auxerre win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90+2' Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Francois Letexier blows for a foul after Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
88' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
88' Paris FC will take a corner kick.
88' Wow, what an escape. Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
86' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
86' The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
84' Auxerre are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
81' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
81' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Auxerre are awarded a corner kick.
79' Stephane Gilli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) replacing Ciro Immobile.
78' Substitution. Sekou Mara (Auxerre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Naouirou Ahamada walks off.
77' 8:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
75' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

74' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Auxerre.
73' Auxerre have a free kick from a promising distance.
72' A yellow card for bad language! Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

70' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Donovan Leon has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
67' Auxerre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) was too forceful with his tackle and Francois Letexier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
65' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilan Kebbal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC).
63' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Moses Simon will be replaced by Luca Koleosho (Paris FC).
61' The substitution is prepared. Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Josue Casimir.
61' Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
59' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
59' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
57' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
57' Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
56' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
55' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
54' Moses Simon (Paris FC) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
53' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
51' The Paris FC players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) serves up a nice cross, but Kevin Trapp punches the ball away.
50' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
47' Looks like Alimani Gory (Paris FC) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
46' Stephane Gilli makes a half-time substitution. Marshall Munetsi comes on in place of Adama Camara (Paris FC).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

42' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
41' Flag goes up against Lamine Sy (Auxerre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
39' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
38' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Paris FC is cautioned for aggressive play.
36' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Ciro Immobile (Paris FC), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
34' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
30' What a miskick by Moses Simon (Paris FC). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
30' Paris FC failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
29' Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) is caught offside!
29' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Moses Simon (Paris FC) takes it short.
28' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ciro Immobile (Paris FC). The ball goes out of play and Paris FC have been awarded a corner kick.
25' A pass from Lamine Sy (Auxerre) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
24' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
23' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
20' Some great play by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Donovan Leon sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
20' Flag up against Josue Casimir (Auxerre). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
17' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

14' Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
11' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot well wide of the left post.
10' 46:54 – the latest ball possession ratio.
8' Adama Camara (Paris FC) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
6' The Paris FC players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Josue Casimir (Auxerre) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
